newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-W Australia to outline gold royalty options.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-W Australia to outline gold royalty options.

text.p: The Western Australian state government is scheduled to outline soon to the mining industry options for possibly introducing a gold royalty, state premier Richard Court said on Wednesday.
"I said we would make a decision within a month in relation to what me might be considering," Court told a press conference
"If we are going to consider the options of the gold royalty further, we should not start that process until we sit down with the industry," he said.
Court said options under consideration included a scale system, wherby larger mines would shoulder more of the burden of a royalty to enable small mining companies to grow.
"We haven't considered any specific options," court said.
"But the industry has made it clear to us that if we sit down to discuss the matter, they would want to put forth proposals that would include different scales."
Unlike in New South Wales, Queensland and the Northern Territory, Western Australian gold miners are exempt from paying royalties.
However, the state imposes royalties on other minerals.
Court said state revenues are needed to improve the state's roads and other infrastructure.
Court earlier told a gold conference here that the government had made no decision so far on whether to impose a gold royalty.
